name: GB Emulator
description: Game Boy and Game Boy Color emulator (gnuboy) with responsive scaling, save states and per-device controls.

screenshots.alt: Pokemon Crystal running in the GB Emulator on a 240x320 panel, with the on-screen D-pad, A and B buttons, Start and Select, and a pause button
screenshots.caption: Pokemon Crystal on the Game Boy Color emulator

changelog:
v0.1.0: Initial DMG/CGB emulation via vendored gnuboy, ROM picker, save states and battery saves.
v0.2.0: Absolute-deadline frame pacing (fixes ~26% fast emulation), PPU render skipping on non-displayed frames, async canvas blit, fixed-point canvas scaler, and native-style pause menu and About page.
